schema.name: dvmf_negctl_sf
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE dvmf_negctl_sf.parent (id INT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT)
CREATE TABLE dvmf_negctl_sf.left_leaf (id INT PRIMARY KEY, parent_id INT, score INT)
CREATE TABLE dvmf_negctl_sf.right_leaf (id INT PRIMARY KEY, parent_id INT, rating INT)

query.defining_query: WITH al AS (SELECT parent_id, sum(score) AS sum_s, count(*) AS cnt_l FROM dvmf_negctl_sf.left_leaf GROUP BY parent_id), ar AS (SELECT parent_id, avg(rating) AS avg_r, count(*) AS cnt_r FROM dvmf_negctl_sf.right_leaf GROUP BY parent_id) SELECT p.id, p.name, al.sum_s, al.cnt_l, ar.avg_r, ar.cnt_r FROM dvmf_negctl_sf.parent p LEFT JOIN al ON al.parent_id = p.id LEFT JOIN ar ON ar.parent_id = p.id

mutations.sql: UPDATE dvmf_negctl_sf.right_leaf SET rating = 3 WHERE id = 1 RETURNING 1

negative_control.reason: Schema/query/mutations are all legitimately correct (copied from cor939_two_leaf_snapshot), but expected_capability.expected_mode is deliberately set to BATCH while requested_refresh_mode is DIFFERENTIAL. The stream table will actually run in DIFFERENTIAL mode, so mode_check in dvm_replay.py (and assert_effective_refresh_mode in the Rust replay path) MUST raise SilentFallback.
